topic: R24 TABLESTYLE border linetype DXF transport

specification.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.field: TABLESTYLE border group 340 LTYPE hard pointer

behavior: R24 TABLESTYLE accepts a non-null border LTYPE only when dxfWriteSourceLinetypeTargetHandle resolves a uniquely registered source LTYPE to its emitted handle.
The writer serializes the resolved handle as group 340; null handles remain zero.
Unknown source handles are rejected instead of being passed through numerically.

cases: Existing null-handle ASCII and Binary R24 TABLESTYLE profiles remain covered.
ASCII and Binary output with one uniquely emitted TABLE_BORDER_LTYPE is freshly imported; the typed border group-340 handle equals the emitted LTYPE table record handle.
An unresolved border handle is refused while preserving a pre-existing destination sentinel.
The corrected profile succeeds on the same adapter after the failure.
The raw captured TABLESTYLE group-340 values are checked for well-formed handles and expected non-null references.
control.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture is committed; output is created under the system temporary directory and removed.

limits: This is generated DXF transport and typed readback evidence for the bounded R24 profile.
It does not qualify a physical DWG TABLESTYLE producer profile, native rendering behavior, whole-source conversion, or general TABLESTYLE support.
It does not change AC1027 aggregate source-reference or HEADER admission gates.
